coverage_note: Opening 00:00-06:26 is English chat about a song (Amal's Arabic shows as '[foreign language]'); speaking practice 06:28-10:40 (date, time, weather, clothes); 10:40-1:00:35 is a listening/translation drill of make-X vs get-X verbs (Amal says Arabic, Medi translates), so most rows are mode=listening. Not rows: 08:54/09:04 ابل امبارح (qaf->hamza, S4); 09:56-10:01 بياض/أبيض -> بيضة self-fixed before Amal's بيضة; 10:08 رسمي -> قميص رسمي self-fix; 34:46 'are you scared--were you scared' self-fix; 57:50 'you guys enjoyed with him' is right (chat enbas6tu ma3o). Engine: 14:17 'back su-- back sir' likely kasar; 47:22 'too much fucked' = engine noise; 20:04 بيساع = his echo of بيزعل. Echo candidate 'Oh, the smell.' at 09:40 is real English, not an echo.

rows.medi_said: This is it today. تسعة عشرين.
rows.why: He said 'nine twenty' (29) for the 19th; Amal answered '19.' and he then said تسعطاش (sheet: nineteen | tese3ta3sh).

rows.medi_said: تسعش ستة.
rows.why: He gave the month as six; Amal first queried 'ستة؟' (07:04) then recast تسعطاش تسعة (19th of the 9th) and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: اليوم الجو بتغي-- بتغير كتير. No, بغير كتير.
rows.amal_said: So تغير، no be. ... It changed؟
rows.why: He used a b- present for a change that already happened; Amal said 'تغير, no be' / 'It changed?' and he agreed 'past tense, you're right'.
rows.english: the weather changed a lot today

rows.medi_said: uh، أزرق، uh، كمي
rows.why: He reached for 'dark' with كمي (not a word for it) and Amal supplied غامق (sheet: dark (color) | 8aameq), which he repeated; could be an engine-cut start of the word.

rows.medi_said: you took a photo or I, I take a photo? ... So it's اتصورت, right?
rows.amal_said: Is it did you take a photo or did you get-- did you take a photo of yourself؟ Like, did you get photographed؟
rows.why: He read the t- (get-X) form اتصورت as active 'took a photo'; Amal pushed 'did you get photographed?' until he said 'I got photographed'.

rows.medi_said: you are tired of me.
rows.why: تعبتني is make-X (you tired me); Amal said 'No that's تعبت مني'.

rows.medi_said: Why did you smile to a male or why did she smile?
rows.right: why do you smile / why are you laughing
rows.why: ليش بتضحك has the present b-; he gave a past, Amal asked 'did or do?' and he switched to present.

rows.medi_said: Isn't this to inflict sadness? The past tense. ... Okay, I was sad.
rows.why: He heard زهقت as زعلت (sad); Amal said 'زهقت مش زعلت'.

rows.medi_said: They had fun or they enjoyed?
rows.amal_said: آآآ. Close بس that would be انبسطوا. انبسطوا
rows.why: Amal said 'Close but' and he changed to 'you guys enjoyed' - the person ending was misread.

rows.medi_said: What boring hap-- What happened boring?
rows.why: He took بيزعل for 'boring' (بيزهق); Amal: 'No, بيزعل مش بيزهق'. (At 20:04 he also echoed it as بيساع and she repeated بيزعل.)

rows.medi_said: He will not, he will not bore you.
rows.amal_said: Very close. أزهقك، not يزهقك. أزهقك.
rows.why: He read the a- (I) prefix as 'he'; Amal: 'أزهقك, not يزهقك'.

rows.medi_said: Were you sad from what happened?
rows.amal_said: Very close. بس مش sad. انزعجتي.
rows.why: He took انزعجتي as 'sad'; Amal: 'بس مش sad'.
rows.english: did you get annoyed by what happened?

rows.medi_said: so don't be tired of me.
rows.amal_said: That's ما تتعبي مني. ما تعبيني.
rows.why: ما تعبيني is make-X; Amal said 'That's ما تتعبي مني' and he fixed to 'don't make me tired'.

rows.medi_said: She laughed at him.
rows.why: He read علي as 'at him'; Amal repeated علي and he fixed to 'at me'.

rows.medi_said: Who was he mad with you-- at you? I don't... This doesn't make sense.
rows.amal_said: What's ضايقك؟ ... So is it ضايق or it's ضايقة to be upset؟
rows.wrong: Who was he mad with you
rows.why: ضايقك is make-X (upset someone); Amal asked what ضايق means and which form is 'to be upset' until he said 'who made you upset'.

rows.medi_said: Basat is to be made happy, right? ... So بسطت is I was happy.
rows.amal_said: مهم. So بسطت first. ... I made.
rows.why: He read بسطت as 'I was happy'; Amal said 'I made' and he agreed 'this is inflicting... I made him happy'.

rows.medi_said: You guys...
rows.why: He started 'you guys' for بينبسطوا; Amal repeated the word and he gave 'they are happy'.
rows.english: they are happy when they see me

rows.medi_said: ما تحمسي ... Uh, لسه ما... er ما تحمسي لسه
rows.why: He said ما تحمسي (don't excite) for 'don't be excited'; Amal recast ما تتحمسي لسه and he said 'Oh, that's right'.

rows.medi_said: Yeah, they apologized. Present tense.
rows.why: He called اتأسفوا present; Amal: 'لأ, اتأسفوا not بيتأسفوا'.

rows.medi_said: I ruined the, the s- the trip.
rows.amal_said: Are you sure؟ I ruined؟ ... That would be خربت. خربت.
rows.why: He read خربت السفرة as 'I ruined' then 'she ruined'; Amal pushed back twice until 'the trip was ruined'.

rows.medi_said: who was made happy by us?
rows.why: He read انبسط as passive 'was made happy'; Amal repeated انبسط and he offered 'who enjoyed'.

rows.medi_said: who was made happy or who enjoyed from us?
rows.why: He heard معنا as منا ('I was saying mina'); Amal: 'With us. معنا'.

rows.medi_said: Uh, are you excited to a girl?
rows.why: تحمستِ is past; Amal recast 'Did you get excited?' and he took it.

rows.medi_said: بزهق ... بزهّق ... Is it zar-zarha, zar'a?
rows.why: Asked for 'bored' he gave the verb بزهق/بزهّق; Amal said 'That's boring' and supplied the adjective (sheet: bored | Zahqaan | زهقان).

rows.medi_said: uh, don't be annoyed.
rows.why: He took تزعلوا as 'annoyed'; Amal queried 'Annoyed?' and he fixed to 'don't be sad'.

rows.medi_said: She was happy. ... I enjoyed to it. No, Aloo, uh, Bill.
rows.amal_said: No، انبسطت له. انبسطت له. Just the verb. I got happy له.
rows.why: He read انبسطت له as 'she was happy' and له as 'to it/from him'; Amal said 'No' and 'I got happy له ... for him'.

rows.medi_said: You guys don't be annoyed.
rows.why: ما تزعجوه is make-X with -uh; Amal: 'تزعجوه, not تنزعجوا', then 'توه' until he said 'to him'.

rows.medi_said: They made us sad.
rows.why: He read the -ni ending as 'us'; Amal repeated زعلوني and he fixed to 'me'.

rows.medi_said: So it made me happy...
rows.amal_said: صح، it made happy، بس is it past or present؟
rows.why: بيبسطني has b- present; Amal asked 'past or present?' and he said 'it makes me happy'.

rows.medi_said: you came. Aji, you said, "It makes me happy he came."
rows.why: He read آجي as 'you/he came'; Amal: 'آجي. I come.'
rows.english: it makes me happy to come

rows.medi_said: Did, uh, did you guys enjoy to me? ... Oh, they enjoyed...
rows.amal_said: انبسطولي. ... They got-- they were happy for me.
rows.wrong: did you guys enjoy to me
rows.why: He read انبسطولي as 'you guys enjoyed to me'; Amal repeated and recast 'they were happy for me'.
